summary: TNL Mediagene furnished a Form -K reporting that on October 14, 2026 Nasdaq confirmed regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1 minimum bid price requirement, under the Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision dated August 23, 2026. Continued listing remains conditional: the company must demonstrate compliance with Rule 5550(b)(1), requiring at least $2.5 million in stockholders' equity, on or before October 30, 2026, and it remains non-compliant. Shares trade as TNMG during the exception period, pending Panel review of any submission. Failure could trigger delisting; watch the equity-rule submission and any capital-raising to cure the shortfall.
